e2e.auth_notes: The actor is the seeded student 小明 (balance 80, enrolled in courses 1 and 4), whose credentials come from the sample .env only.

db.notes: Selecting 养猪入门 (course 7, price 10) as 小明 inserts one student_course row (progress 0, has_exam 0, mark null) and updates student 24's balance 80 -> 70. expected_delta.json is captured from the pristine app (never hand-written). The schema has no volatile columns (no timestamps/counters): every seeded date is fixed in the dump and the flows fill any date input explicitly, so ignore_columns is empty. All six tables are listed so the capture tooling can warn about any change outside the spec. Shiro sessions live in memory, not in the DB — there is no session table to exclude.
